prompts: Use case: precise-object-edit / tracing. Edit the supplied image into a FAITHFUL TRANSPARENT OUTLINE TRACING of its UPPER 62 PERCENT ONLY. Preserve the exact upper composition and perspective of the reference: colossal sealed double gate in upper center, receding sentence-steles left and right, diagonal suspended chains, and the suspended sentencing platform immediately beneath the gate. Exclude the large foreground stairs and all the lower abyss. Wide landscape output around 2.2:1 aspect ratio. This is not a redesign: trace the original architectural silhouettes and major structural contours in their original relative positions. Draw ONLY fine pale ivory-gray continuous contour lines with a few slightly heavier primary outlines: outer roof edges, gate posts and door divisions, stele edges and caps, individual clearly linked chain loops, platform rim and hanging rock outline. Keep lines crisp and readable at 700px wide. Sparse interior architectural lines only. ABSOLUTELY NO SOLID FILLS in buildings, no black silhouettes, no opaque dark panels, no shading, no hatching, no textures, no fog, no clouds, no light beams, no atmosphere, no ground, no shadows, no scenery, no color wash. All enclosed shapes and all spaces between lines must be genuinely transparent alpha zero; the deliverable consists exclusively of thin strokes floating on transparency. No red annotation or boundary drawn. No people, faces, text or extra objects. Do not make a rectangle frame; whole outline composition breathes in empty transparent space, 4 percent padding to keep every major silhouette unclipped.

Precise cleanup edit of this line drawing. Keep all existing bright ivory outline strokes in their exact positions. DELETE all gray fill and gray shading inside every gate panel, pillar, tombstone, chain link, rooftop and platform. DELETE all glow and haze around the lines. Replace those deleted pixels with true 100% transparency. The final file should contain ONLY narrow clean white lines, as a sparse technical contour drawing on transparent background. Large flat areas between lines MUST be entirely empty transparent, not gray, not black, not white. In particular the enormous center door must have only its edge contours, a center seam and a few structural vertical strokes: the spaces between these strokes are completely empty. Same for the side steles. Reduce tiny decorative texture marks and hatching so the main shapes read cleanly. Do not add any fills or new objects. No background. Preserve the current landscape size and architectural composition.
export: Resize to 1024x466; Canvas mask retains bright strokes only (minRGB>238, alpha>96), discards grey wash; normalize stroke RGB to white. Runtime source-in tint preserves empty interiors.
composition: Upper reference architecture only; no foreground staircase or abyss.
